_comment: A simulated live workload for a customer-support agent (the file-06 / elevator-pitch example). Mix of easy (routine, cacheable, repeated) and hard (high-stakes) queries across tenants. 'repeats' expands each into N near-duplicate phrasings to exercise the semantic cache.

requests.question: how do i reset my password
paraphrases: forgot my password how to reset
cant log in need password reset

requests.question: i was double charged and need a refund to a closed card
paraphrases: charged twice card now closed how refund
double billed and my card is cancelled

requests.question: explain how your data retention policy affects gdpr deletion requests
paraphrases: gdpr delete my data but you keep backups explain
how does retention work with a right to be forgotten request
